hide.why: Weathered stony gargoyle hide on the chest and arm: fine pits and chisel marks for the head, jowls and snout.

masonry.why: Irregular carved blocks about 15 x 6 native px after sampling: the bastions, chimneys, buttresses and belly.

membrane.why: Wrinkled, veined leather filling the frame: the bat-wing solar sails.

plating.why: Riveted hull panels with seams, hatches and greeble modules inside the frame border: tiled over every hull plate of the armada (2026-11 boss armada round).

rejected.stone_texture-652300: Regular brick courses, too uniform for carved stone.
rejected.membrane-652200: A whole bat on a flat ground rather than a membrane surface.
